🎃 Welcome to JeoParty — Halloween Edition

Ten complete Halloween games are already loaded. Pick your crowd and press play — there is nothing to write, upload or set up.

⚡ Start in 30 seconds

  1. Open 🎃 Games in the top bar and choose the game that matches your guests.
  2. Rename the four teams, or keep The Ghouls, Witch Please, Pumpkin Spice and Bat Attitude.
  3. Click Game Board, then click any tile. That's the whole setup.

Tap 🔈 Ambience in the top bar for wind, distant thunder and the occasional howl.

🍬 Ten games, one for every crowd

  • Little Monsters — ages 5–10, nothing frightening.
  • Tween Scream — ages 10–14. Goosebumps, Scooby-Doo, spooky games.
  • Family Night — all ages together.
  • Around the World — Day of the Dead, Obon, Samhain and more.
  • Witches & Folklore — teens and up. Salem, superstition, legends.
  • Adult Party — the default game.
  • Second Helping — a whole second adult game.
  • Costume Party — dressing up, done properly.
  • Haunted History — real hauntings and unsolved mysteries.
  • Horror Buff — genuinely hard. Film nerds only.

🎃 Trick-or-Treat tiles

Two tiles on every board are secretly rigged, and nobody knows which.

  • Land on one and that team wagers — up to their score, or the top tile value if they're broke.
  • Right answer wins the wager. Wrong answer loses it. No one else may steal it.
  • Set how many (0–3) in Settings. Restart Round hides them somewhere new.

🕯️ Set the mood

  • Six Halloween themes — Classic, Pumpkin Glow, Haunted Purple, Blood Moon, Witch's Brew, and a bright kid-safe Friendly mode.
  • Atmosphere — fog, bats, ghosts, falling candy, cobwebs, a rising moon and lightning. Three levels, including Maximum Haunting.
  • Music — a cinematic Halloween soundtrack loops under the whole game. Set Sound Effects and Music levels separately in Settings.
  • Turn any of it off if you're projecting from an older laptop.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Teams & scoring

  • Up to five teams, each with a spooky emoji.
  • The team in play is highlighted on the board.
  • Click a tile, read it aloud, then click Show Answer.
  • Click the team that got it right — or Incorrect, which deducts and passes the turn.

🏆 The finale

  • When the last tile is gone, Final JeoParty begins automatically.
  • Every team wagers in secret before the question is revealed.
  • Still tied? Sudden Death settles it — one question, first correct team wins.
  • Candy and bats rain down on the winners.

🖨️ Paper backups

The Print tab builds two sheets from whichever game is loaded:

  • Team Score Sheet — a blank tally grid for your scorekeeper.
  • Host Answer Key — every question and answer, so you can host from paper and leave the screen to the players.

Choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog to keep a copy.

✍️ Want your own questions?

You don't need them — but you can. Every question is editable in Settings, or click Download CSV Sample, fill it in a spreadsheet, and import it. Great for an office party or a themed birthday.

  • Your game saves itself in this browser. Close the tab and come back to it.
  • Export Game Data saves a file you can send to a friend or open on another computer.
  • Reset Game clears the scores and board but keeps your teams and questions.
  • New Game restores the factory setup. Export first if you've written your own.
  • Everything runs offline in one file. No account, no subscription, no internet needed.
